text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's not here... It's gone?! It was 
supposed to be right here!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yo, what's up! You're totally panicking, 
huh? Tell me what happened real quick!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yan-ko-san! The thing is, we can't find 
the remote control that operates the stage 
equipment...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha, gotcha... Well, it'll work out 
somehow! C'mon, wipe that look off your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yeah, I could totally ad-lib 
through the stage and brush it off— but 
that wouldn't be our best, right~?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
So why don't we hit up a certain someone! 
—A 'Great Detective'!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I see, I see...! Got it! Leave 'How 
to make an awesome stage' to Great 
Detective Urara~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Yan-ko-san has an event in this 
shopping district today, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We wanna make it something that brings 
smiles to everyone! Is there anything 
special you'd love to see~?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, sorry kiddo, I wouldn't really know 
about that stuff... Maybe you should ask 
someone else.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you anyway! In that case... I 
think I'll start asking from that end over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Wait, are you planning on asking 
every single shopkeeper in this entire 
street?! ...A-Alright, I can at least help 
you ask around!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, you must be Urara-chan! You've 
been going around asking everyone all day, 
haven't you? The neighborhood association 
president was just talking about how hard 
you're working.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Since we're doing it, I want it to be 
something that really squeezes your heart 
with joy!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how lovely. Let's see, 'How to make 
an awesome stage'... Would it be alright 
if I contacted you if I think of anything?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, I couldn't come up with any good 
ideas~. I'm sorry... Yan-ko-san.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
No way, not at all! You worked super-duper 
hard, Urara! Leave the rest to me... Wait, 
huh—?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District People
text_block_list.text:
"Urara-chan! If there's anything we can 
do, just say the word!" "We're all here to 
lend a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Everyone from the shopping 
district! Did you all come here to help 
out?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Of course we did! How could we just ignore 
a kid working this hard!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real?! That's so insane!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And look at how many people showed up! 
Ahaha! With a crew like this— there's 
nothing we can't pull off!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Radio Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much for gathering today. 
Forever Young is currently proceeding down 
the main street—"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! I'm Forever Young, straight 
outta Tracen Academy~!

text_block_list.name: Voices of Event Attendees
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! It's really Forever Young!" 
"Yang-ko~~!! Kyaah~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
How's that! How's the lighting looking! 
They're meant for shop displays, so I just 
hope it ain't blindingly bright!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It looks amazing! ...You're incredible, 
Yang-ko-san! Coming up with a stage like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?! We're doing a parade!? But how are 
we gonna do that~?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"By borrowing everyone's strength here! 
Course, we'll need to set up a few 
arrangements, but still. Thanks to you, 
Urara, it's gonna turn out totally lit♪"

text_block_list.name: Voices of Event Attendees
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaah, Young-chan! You're so cool--!" 
"Man, this gave me the energy to tackle 
work tomorrow...!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, everyone's smiling! I'm so 
glaad~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Urara. You're not seriously 
planning on just sticking to playing 
helper today, are you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious~? We're gonna do this 
together!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna pull off an innovation that'll 
make everyone smile way, way more!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having caught wind that an Umamusume event 
was taking place, I went over to check out 
the situation--

text_block_list.name: Voices of Event Attendees
text_block_list.text:
"U U U U U U U U U U U UMA! U U U UMA! U U 
U U U UMA!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
This is super fun~!! Thank you, 
Yang-ko-san!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I'm having super crazy fun too! ...Wait, 
that great detective talk you gave really 
wasn't just for show, huh!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Could it be you've got some real talent 
for it? Having connections with a great 
detective gets me so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Yang-ko-san, if anything ever 
comes up again, just let me know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Great Detective Urara will solve 
absolutely everything for you!
